judged_text: findMembers builds the request URL from the live `name` property, which is two-way bound to the editable name text-field on the admin group form, so paginating or adding members after editing the name (before saving) queries a group name that does not exist. An admin who types a new name and then clicks next/previous or Add triggers GET /groups/<edited-name>/members.json, which 404s; the member list silently fails to refresh, so addMembers appears to do nothing even though the PUT succeeded.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers()` builds the URL from `this.get('name')` (`/groups/` + name + `/members.json`). In the admin template `group.hbs`, the group name is edited via `{{text-field ... value=name}}`, which two-way binds directly to the model’s `name`. The new pagination actions (`next`/`previous` in `admin-group.js.es6`) and the post-add refresh (`addMembers()` -> `Group#addMembers()` -> `self.findMembers()`) call `findMembers()` again before the rename is saved server-side. If the admin types a new name and clicks next/previous/Add, the client will request `/groups/<edited-name>/members.json`, but the server `GroupsController#members` looks up by group name (`find_group` using `lower(name)`), so the edited (unsaved) name can fail to resolve, breaking member refresh/pagination exactly as described.
